question: How many casual and sick leave days do I get?
expected_answer: 8 casual leave and 8 sick leave days per financial year. A medical certificate is needed for sick leave of more than 2 consecutive days.
answer: Casual Leave (CL): 8 days; Sick Leave (SL): 8 days. These leave types are pro-rated in the year of joining.
